bio: This romantic and welcoming dining space inside the charming Villa San Pietro along the busy Rua Augusta has the feel of an authentic Parisian bistro. Run by renowned French chef Alain Poletto, the restaurant showcases classic French cuisine with a focus on traditional recipes and the use of top-quality ingredients. Here, you can enjoy dishes such as the superbly prepared and authentic Pâté de Campagne, and beef bourguignon with home-produced bacon and onions, served with vegetables and a delicious red wine sauce. To complete your meal, the traditional and mouthwatering caramelised Tarte Tatin highlights why this superb restaurant is an absolute must! The choice of beverages on offer here is equally impressive....
